user.title: Connect Träwelling
user.description: Create a personal access token at traewelling.de → Settings → API/Applications with the scopes read-statuses, read-statistics plus (for check-in and likes) write-statuses and write-likes.

reconfigure.title: Change token
reconfigure.description: Enter a new access token, e.g. one that additionally has the write-statuses scope for check-ins.

error.invalid_auth: Token invalid or missing required scopes.

abort.already_configured: This Träwelling account is already set up.

data_description.active_interval: Journeys and friends are polled at this rate (default 60 s). The active journey is only checked while one of your journeys is running or about to start – otherwise every 5 min.
data_description.stats_interval: Profile points and friends leaderboard at this rate. Periods, favourites and history only after your own check-ins, on date change or at least every 6 h (Träwelling caches these server-side anyway).
data_description.stats_from: Start date for the all-time statistics.

search_stations.name: Search stations
search_stations.description: Search stations by name or coordinates. Without parameters: home station and recently used stations.

checkin.name: Check in
checkin.description: Check in to a trip on Träwelling. Requires the write-statuses scope.

start_id.name: Start station ID
start_id.description: Station ID of the boarding stop.

destination_id.name: Destination station ID
destination_id.description: Station ID of the exit stop.

ticket_id.name: Ticket
ticket_id.description: ID of a ticket to attach to the check-in.

get_tickets.name: Get tickets
get_tickets.description: Your tickets valid on a given day, plus the suggested (last used) ticket.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day the ticket must be valid on (default: today).

like.name: Like status
like.description: Like a status on Träwelling (or remove the like). Requires the write-likes scope.
